"""Serve the local Avatar viewer. Personal records are read only when explicitly enabled."""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import sqlite3
import subprocess
import threading
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Optional
from urllib.parse import urlsplit

from avatar_common import AvatarError
from avatar_analysis import analyze_records
from avatar_view import show

WEB = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / 'web'
ASSETS = {'/': ('index.html', 'text/html'), '/index.html': ('index.html', 'text/html'),
          '/style.css': ('style.css', 'text/css'), '/app.mjs': ('app.mjs', 'text/javascript'),
          '/analysis.mjs': ('analysis.mjs', 'text/javascript'),
          '/ai.mjs': ('ai.mjs', 'text/javascript'),
          '/content.mjs': ('content.mjs', 'text/javascript'),
          '/illustrations.mjs': ('illustrations.mjs', 'text/javascript')}
ASSETS.update({
    '/stories': ('stories.html', 'text/html'),
    '/stories.html': ('stories.html', 'text/html'),
    '/stories.css': ('stories.css', 'text/css'),
    '/stories.mjs': ('stories.mjs', 'text/javascript'),
    '/story-content.mjs': ('story-content.mjs', 'text/javascript'),
    '/story-model.mjs': ('story-model.mjs', 'text/javascript'),
})


def make_server(port: int, home: Optional[Path] = None, ai: bool = False) -> ThreadingHTTPServer:
    analysis_lock = threading.Lock()

    class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
        def log_message(self, format: str, *args: object) -> None:
            pass

        def send(self, status: int, body: bytes, content_type: str) -> None:
            self.send_response(status)
            self.send_header('Content-Type', content_type + '; charset=utf-8')
            self.send_header('Content-Length', str(len(body)))
            self.send_header('Cache-Control', 'no-store')
            self.send_header('X-Content-Type-Options', 'nosniff')
            self.send_header('Referrer-Policy', 'no-referrer')
            self.send_header('Content-Security-Policy',
                             "default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; "
                             "img-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self'; "
                             "frame-ancestors 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'")
            self.end_headers()
            self.wfile.write(body)

        def json(self, status: int, data: object) -> None:
            self.send(status, json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False).encode('utf-8'),
                      'application/json')

        def allowed(self) -> bool:
            expected = '127.0.0.1:' + str(self.server.server_port)
            host = self.headers.get('Host', '')
            origin = self.headers.get('Origin')
            return host == expected and (origin is None or origin == 'http://' + expected)

        def do_GET(self) -> None:
            if not self.allowed():
                self.json(403, {'error': 'Only this local viewer can read these records.'})
                return
            path = urlsplit(self.path).path
            if path == '/api/config':
                self.json(200, {'ai': ai, 'local_records': home is not None})
                return
            if path == '/api/records':
                if home is None:
                    self.json(403, {'error': 'Start the viewer with --home to enable local records.'})
                    return
                try:
                    self.json(200, show(home.expanduser() / 'avatar.db'))
                except (OSError, sqlite3.Error, AvatarError, ValueError):
                    self.json(422, {'error': 'Cannot read this Avatar store. Check it with avatar show.'})
                return
            asset = ASSETS.get(path)
            if asset is None:
                self.json(404, {'error': 'Not found.'})
                return
            try:
                self.send(200, (WEB / asset[0]).read_bytes(), asset[1])
            except OSError:
                self.json(404, {'error': 'Viewer asset not found.'})

        def do_POST(self) -> None:
            if not self.allowed():
                self.json(403, {'error': 'Only this local viewer can request analysis.'})
                return
            if self.command != 'POST' or self.path != '/api/analyze':
                self.json(405, {'error': 'This viewer does not write Avatar records.'})
                return
            if not ai:
                self.json(403, {'error': 'Start with --ai claude to enable analysis.'})
                return
            if self.headers.get('Content-Type', '').split(';')[0] != 'application/json':
                self.json(415, {'error': 'Expected application/json.'})
                return
            try:
                length = int(self.headers.get('Content-Length', '0'))
                if not 0 < length <= 1_000_000:
                    raise ValueError('Invalid body length.')
            except ValueError:
                self.json(413, {'error': 'The request must be at most 1 MB.'})
                return
            if not analysis_lock.acquire(blocking=False):
                self.json(429, {'error': 'An analysis is already running.'})
                return
            try:
                self.connection.settimeout(15)
                payload = json.loads(self.rfile.read(length).decode('utf-8'))
                self.json(200, analyze_records(payload))
            except (ValueError, UnicodeError):
                self.json(422, {'error': '분석할 기록이나 반환된 근거를 확인하지 못했어요. 기록을 줄여 다시 시도해주세요.'})
            except (RuntimeError, OSError, subprocess.TimeoutExpired):
                self.json(503, {'error': 'Claude 분석을 마치지 못했어요. CLI 로그인·사용량을 확인하고 다시 시도해주세요.'})
            finally:
                analysis_lock.release()

        do_PUT = do_POST
        do_DELETE = do_POST
        do_PATCH = do_POST

    return ThreadingHTTPServer(('127.0.0.1', port), Handler)


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--port', type=int, default=4173)
    parser.add_argument('--home', type=Path, help='Explicit Avatar home to expose read-only.')
    parser.add_argument('--ai', choices=['claude'], help='Enable opt-in analysis through Claude CLI.')
    args = parser.parse_args()
    server = make_server(args.port, args.home, args.ai == 'claude')
    print('Avatar: http://127.0.0.1:' + str(server.server_port), flush=True)
    print('Personal records: ' + ('enabled read-only' if args.home else 'not connected'), flush=True)
    try:
        server.serve_forever()
    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        pass
    finally:
        server.server_close()


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import sys
import tempfile
import threading
import unittest
from pathlib import Path
from urllib.error import HTTPError
from urllib.request import Request, urlopen
from unittest.mock import patch

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / 'scripts'))
from avatar_web import make_server


class AvatarWebTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self) -> None:
        self.temp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.home = Path(self.temp.name) / 'absent'
        self.server = make_server(0, self.home)
        self.thread = threading.Thread(target=self.server.serve_forever, daemon=True)
        self.thread.start()
        self.base = 'http://127.0.0.1:' + str(self.server.server_port)

    def tearDown(self) -> None:
        self.server.shutdown()
        self.server.server_close()
        self.thread.join()
        self.temp.cleanup()

    def test_records_are_read_only_and_do_not_create_an_absent_store(self) -> None:
        with urlopen(self.base + '/api/records') as response:
            self.assertEqual(json.load(response)['choices'], [])
            self.assertEqual(response.headers['Cache-Control'], 'no-store')

    def test_static_root_and_security_headers(self) -> None:

    def test_story_preview_and_modules_are_available_without_reading_records(self) -> None:

    def test_foreign_origin_and_host_are_rejected(self) -> None:

avatar/README.md:
# Avatar

Avatar is a local CLI and host skill for reviewing explicitly recorded choices and
user-confirmed personal criteria. It keeps quoted reasons, provenance, versions, revocations, and
read-only Distill history projections in SQLite.

Avatar does not collect conversations automatically, infer personality, authenticate speakers, or
promote project exceptions into personal criteria. It works without Stage or Distill.

## Requirements

- Python 3.9 or newer
- No third-party packages

The default database is `~/.avatar/avatar.db`. Override it with `--home <directory>` or the
`AVATAR_HOME` environment variable. The database stays outside the plugin installation cache.

## Commands

Run commands from this repository with `python3 avatar/scripts/avatar.py`. From an installed host
plugin, resolve `scripts/avatar.py` from the plugin root.

```text
avatar choice add --idempotency-key <key> --payload-file <json>
avatar criterion propose --idempotency-key <key> --payload-file <json>
avatar criterion confirm <PC-id> --version <N> --idempotency-key <key> --payload-file <json>
avatar criterion revise <PC-id> --idempotency-key <key> --payload-file <json>
avatar criterion revoke <PC-id> --idempotency-key <key> --payload-file <json>
avatar source attach --idempotency-key <key> --file <distill-history.json>
avatar show [--choice <CH-id> | --criterion <PC-id>] [--json]
avatar export
avatar check --refs <avatar-ref,...>
```

All mutating commands require an idempotency key. Replaying the same request returns the original
result with `replayed: true`. Reusing the key for different content returns
`E_IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT` and writes nothing.

Confirmation creates a new immutable version and returns its ref. For example, confirming
proposal `@1` returns confirmed version `@2`. Use the returned ref. Revision creates a new
unconfirmed proposal; it does not reuse the earlier user's confirmation as its source.

## Data boundaries

- `CH-` records belong to Avatar and describe one explicit choice.
- `PC-` records belong to Avatar and describe versioned personal criteria.
- Distill `CR-` history is stored as a read-only projection. `show` labels it historical and does
  not claim that it is current.
- `export` emits `criteria-snapshot/1` with `scope: personal`. It includes only the current
  `user_confirmed` versions.
- `check` returns `eligible_current`, `proposed`, `superseded`, `revoked`, `scope_mismatch`, or
  `unknown`. Consumers must apply only `eligible_current` refs.

## Local web preview

Run `python3 avatar/scripts/avatar_web.py` from the repository root, then open
`http://127.0.0.1:4173`. The first screen uses clearly marked fictional records.
Import a file created with `python3 avatar/scripts/avatar.py show --json > avatar-records.json`.
Files are processed in the browser tab. Import alone does not upload them. The preview does not persist imported
records or reflection notes; download the report before closing or refreshing the tab.

To explicitly connect a local store, start the viewer with `--home <avatar-directory>` and click
the local-record button. The server reads that store only after the request. It never writes records.
Without `--home`, local-store access is disabled, including the default `~/.avatar` store.

The preview summarizes linked criteria, differing choices, and wording revisions deterministically.
It does not infer fixed personality traits or validate psychological constructs. Imported
criteria reflect the file's capture time; use the CLI `check` before relying on them for a decision.
Limits: 8 MiB per imported file and 2,000 choices or criteria. External history projections are not
treated as current criteria. Reports include private source text, so review them before sharing.

To enable optional AI reflection, install and sign in to Claude Code CLI, then start with
`python3 avatar/scripts/avatar_web.py --ai claude`. Select 1–60 records in the viewer, inspect the
exact payload, and confirm before sending. Questions, choices, quoted reasons, project names,
conditions, and referenced criterion versions go to Claude using the signed-in account's usage.
Origin paths and unrelated record metadata are excluded. Imported criteria are marked with their
confirmation, current-version, and revocation status; they are not silently adopted.

The CLI runs Sonnet without tools, skills, MCP servers, or saved sessions. Each interpretation cites
supplied choice IDs and includes an alternative explanation. Unknown evidence IDs fail validation.
This checks references, not whether an interpretation is correct. Users can add corrections to the
downloaded report; these notes do not update the underlying criteria. No analysis runs on page load.
AI requests are limited to one at a time and a 90-second timeout. The browser accepts up to 55,000
JavaScript string units in serialized input; the server separately limits its JSON representation
to 60,000 characters. Individual input text fields are limited to 20,000 characters.

Working-style downloads are user-selected experiments. Public articles are attributed and adapted;
they are not the authors' own AI configurations or endorsements. Downloads do not install themselves
or overwrite project instructions. Attach the file to the intended AI conversation and state its scope.

This localhost preview has no accounts, payments, or public deployment. Do not expose this stdlib
development server through a public proxy. The Korean UI is a first product preview.

### Fictional conversation preview

Open `http://127.0.0.1:4173/stories` to read two fictional people in Korean or English.
The records and interpretations are edited examples, not a live conversation-analysis feature.
Read three scenes, inspect the source text and context, compare interpretations across scenes,
and edit an interpretation. Reading order does not establish when the conversations occurred.
Edits and unfinished drafts stay in memory, separately for each person and scene. Reloading clears them. The page has
no AI calls, uploads, analytics, or ad scripts. Its entry link opens a new tab to preserve records
already imported in the main viewer. The rest of the viewer remains in Korean.

## Development

Run the package suite from the repository root:

```bash
python3 -m unittest discover -s avatar/tests -q
python3 -m unittest tests.test_plugin_contracts -q
node --test avatar/tests/*.test.mjs
```
